name: Bifeprunox
summary: Bifeprunox (INN; code name DU-127,090) is an atypical antipsychotic which, similarly to aripiprazole, combines minimal D2 receptor agonism with serotonin receptor agonism. It was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia, psychosis, and Parkinson's disease.

pharmacology.text: Bifeprunox is an atypical antipsychotic that is a partial D2 agonist.

uses.text: It was under development for the treatment of schizophrenia, psychosis, and Parkinson's disease.

sideEffects.en: In trials the reported effects included nausea, vomiting and dizziness, with less weight gain than many antipsychotics. A death from liver failure in a trial contributed to its rejection.
sideEffects.zh: 在試驗中回報的反應包括噁心、嘔吐與頭暈，體重增加的程度低於許多抗精神病藥。試驗中一起肝衰竭死亡案例促成了它未獲核准。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在试验中回报的反应包括恶心、呕吐与头晕，体重增加的程度低于许多抗精神病药。试验中一起肝衰竭死亡案例促成了它未获核准。

fact.en: Like aripiprazole, it only partly switches on the dopamine D2 receptor. It was turned down by regulators, partly because one death in a trial was linked to liver failure.
fact.zh: 和阿立哌唑一樣，它只部分開啟多巴胺 D2 受體。它未獲監管機關核准，部分原因是試驗中一起死亡案例與肝衰竭有關。
fact.zhHans: 和阿立哌唑一样，它只部分打开多巴胺 D2 受体。它未获监管机关核准，部分原因是试验中一起死亡案例与肝衰竭有关。
